WITH event_avg AS (
  SELECT link_to_event, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount
  FROM budget
  WHERE amount IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY link_to_event
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(amount) AS mean_amount
  FROM budget
  WHERE amount IS NOT NULL
),
kept AS (
  SELECT ea.link_to_event, ea.avg_amount, oa.mean_amount
  FROM event_avg ea
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
  WHERE ea.avg_amount > oa.mean_amount
)
SELECT link_to_event,
       avg_amount,
       avg_amount - mean_amount AS above_overall_average,
       avg_amount - AVG(avg_amount) OVER () AS difference_from_kept_mean
FROM kept
ORDER BY difference_from_kept_mean DESC
LIMIT 10
